name: io.github.lurnake/folkscale
title: Folkscale
description: Test products, prices and ad copy with country-calibrated synthetic consumer panels.

tools.name: list_countries
tools.description: List available national population blueprints (US, FI, UK, DE, JP, BR, IN + custom).

tools.name: create_panel
tools.description: Generate a census-stratified, psychographically deep national consumer panel.

countryCode.description: ISO-2 country code (e.g., US, FI, UK, DE, JP)

tools.name: estimate_study_cost
tools.description: Compute deterministic study pricing and compute estimate before running a study.

tools.name: run_market_study
tools.description: Run a calibrated SSR market study on a panel and return 5-point Likert PMFs, Top-2-Box, subgroup cross-tabs, verbatims, and Executive Brief.

tools.name: get_study_results
tools.description: Fetch a completed study by ID, optionally recomputed at custom T and epsilon.

tools.name: synthesize_study
tools.description: Generate or refresh an Executive Research Brief (verdict, convergent themes, retain list, sharpest criticisms, willingness to pay, singleton insights, actions).

tools.name: score_quote_ssr
tools.description: Project any single consumer quote onto a calibrated 5-point Likert distribution via SSR.
